preparation: Female weaned Sus scrofa domesticus pigs8–12kg; euthanized; distal trachea/proximal primary bronchi opened and pinned with mucosal surface exposed. Bundles stained0.4mM AlcianBlue8GX,pH7.4. Oxygenated Krebs-glucose buffer warmed37°C; dish inclined20° to maintain air–liquid interface. S1legend calls the field explantedweanedpigtrachea; broader methods include proximalbronchi.
